credits.title: Credits
credits.subtitle: Earn credits by taking part in the community and spend them on cosmetics, boosts and permissions in the shop.

categories.frameDescription: A frame sits around your avatar everywhere it appears. Each preview shows it on your own picture.
categories.colorDescription: Show your username in a colour of your own across the forum.
categories.threadCoverDescription: A thread cover is a photo for one of your own threads. Covers are used up: each one goes on a single thread.
categories.boostDescription: Boosts are used up: each one highlights or bumps one of your own threads for a limited time.
categories.permissionDescription: Permissions unlock features for your account, such as a signature or a profile cover. Most are bought once and kept, and some also come with a rank.

credits.balanceDescription: credits to spend in the shop
credits.loginDescription: Log in to see your balance, buy items and keep track of what you own.

waysToEarn.activity: Stay active: a small bonus every day you visit.
waysToEarn.posts: Start threads and reply to other members.
waysToEarn.awards: Earn awards: each one comes with a bonus.
waysToEarn.referrals: Refer new members and sell in the market.
